# NoSleepApp
> Zero-dependency native macOS menu-bar utility to keep closed-lid MacBooks awake for AI coding agents, torrents, and overnight workloads.

## Project Summary
NoSleepApp enables MacBooks (both Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4 and Intel) to stay awake when the laptop lid is closed on battery power, without requiring an external monitor or AC adapter.

## Key Features
- Clamshell Sleep Prevention: Uses native system power assertions via `pmset -a disablesleep 1`.
- Hardware Heat Elimination: Dims display backlight to 0% via private `DisplayServices.framework` C bindings (`DisplayServicesSetBrightness`).
- Thermal & Battery Protection: Non-negotiable 5-hour safety auto-off timer and instant 20% battery cutoff via native `IOKit.ps` notifications.
- Crash Recovery Reconciler: Detects dead owning PIDs on startup and restores normal sleep if the process was terminated unexpectedly.
- Zero External Dependencies: Pure Swift 5.9 and C, compiling natively with clang/swiftc.

## Installation Methods
- Drag-and-drop DMG: `NoSleepApp.dmg`
- Guided Installer Package: `NoSleepApp.pkg`
- Build from Source: `./scripts/build_app.sh`
